node.statement: Extended inclusion from the uniform corner calculus. Under the root hypotheses and the threshold of node 1.1, define V_n=I_n tensor V by V_n(X_1,X_2)=v_{1,n}(X_1)+v_{2,n}(X_2). There is a universal K_inc such that every V_n is a K_inc*t-homomorphism and satisfies (1-K_inc*t)||X||<=||V_n(X)||<=(1+K_inc*t)||X|| for the C*-direct-sum norm ||X||=max(||X_1||,||X_2||). Thus V is an extended K_inc*t-inclusion.
